name: pen-test-tool
description: Authorized, non-destructive web-application security assessment platform (Phase 1 foundation)

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm -r run test && pnpm run phase0:check
